description: A chain whose only eligible seat is at cap (cap=1, one live agent) reports UNRESOLVED: ChainExhaustedError and check exits 3. Python's cmd_check feeds AccountSelector the real get_cap/_open_counts; selector step 5 only applies a cap when it is set.

home.config_toml:
[accounts.primary]
kind = "codex"
short = "pr"
config_dir_var = "CODEX_HOME"
config_dir = "{{DIR:codex-home}}"
pool = "codex:primary"

[roles.scout]
write_scope = "none"
effort = "low"
on_exhausted = "degrade"
skills = []

[roles.scout.models]
codex = "m"

[projects.sandbox]
path = "{{PROJECT:sandbox}}"

[projects.sandbox.chains]
scout = ["primary"]
